name: Time Sharing
definition: The ability to shift back and forth between two or more activities or sources of information (such as speech, sounds, touch, or other sources).

benchmark.name: StreamingBench
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%), overall average across all 18 StreamingBench tasks
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population: ordinary people following live video, audio and speech streams and answering questions about them as the stream continues.

benchmark.name: AsyncTool
benchmark.metric: AsyncTool overall score (composite of step, sub-task and task-level scores; appears to be on a 0-100 scale)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: office and knowledge workers who routinely juggle several concurrent tasks while waiting on responses (emails, systems, colleagues).
